people.bio: I teach Mathematics and Physics using interactive online whiteboards and practice problems. My goal is to help students in Addis Ababa build strong analytical skills.
I specialize in SAT Prep and English with a focus on practical reading strategies and essay writing. I guide my students step by step to achieve their target university scores.
I teach Chemistry and Biology by breaking down complex scientific concepts into simple real world examples. I am passionate about making science engaging for every learner.
